calculation.description: Fades the completed-session open-to-close return, with a bounded multiplier based on the trailing five-session VIX change. VIX is observation-only and is never traded. Signal uses only information available at the decision timestamp.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR across the full 15-asset cross-section; 1-day signal remains predictive at 5 days but decays by 10 days. High turnover and selective open-data coverage warrant modest ensemble weight.
